verdict.rationale: EFTPS holds sensitive taxpayer and payment data, so whether that data can be kept out of AI model training is a fair privacy question for this kind of service. The evidence pack has no AI-training policy, opt-out control or data-use statement. The missing robots.txt concerns crawler access to the public website, not use of user data for training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
